output.headline: Blackstone has bought twice in the target's own sub-sector, including a Midwest deal, and historically pays well above the comparable-deal range.
output.differentiator: Pays at the top of the priority list: median 17.1x, above the 75th percentile of comparable deals (15.3x), backed by $416.4 billion of private equity assets under management. [K:closed_share, V:comps, P:1]
output.why_them: Pays top-of-list multiples; prior Midwest healthcare services deal

acquirer_overview.title: Large sponsor with a broad record and selective provider exposure
points: Financial sponsor with 25 deals from 2015 to 2024; 22 of 25 (88%) closed, 23 of 25 (92%) were control deals. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share]
Private Equity segment holds $416.4 billion of total assets under management as of December 31, 2025. [P:1]
Only 9 of 25 deals are in provider services; 16 sit outside, and its home sub-sector is Health Insurance. [A:angles, T:record, B:buyer]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Same-sub-sector precedent, though sector and geography signals are only modest
points: Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors and number of past deals are both modest factors in its likelihood. [S:sector_rel, S:activity]
Growth was a motive in 11 of 25 deals and platform build in 9 of 25, which suits an 11.0% grower. [M:high_growth, M:platform_build, X:target]
Two deals in the target's own sub-sector and seven in adjacent provider sub-sectors; it has no open platform, so this would be a new position. [T:record, A:angles]

precedent_activity.title: Four relevant provider deals since 2021, one in the Midwest
points: Peak Medical Management: $342M SPAC Merger, 2021, Midwest, 10.0x EBITDA, closed. Same sub-sector and region as the target. [D:MA-2021-0407]
Evergreen Care Solutions: $299M Bolt-on Acquisition, 2021, same sub-sector, 14.6x, closed. [D:MA-2021-0195]
Dental: Crest Oral Health ($558M Leveraged Buyout, 13.5x) and North Smile Group ($222M Management Buyout, 13.5x), both 2021 and closed. [D:MA-2021-0164, D:MA-2021-0453]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, and Blackstone's own multiples support it
points: Comparable deals: 25th percentile 10.7x, median 12.8x, 75th percentile 15.3x. The 75th percentile is defensible because the 16.8% margin exceeds the comps' 12.9% median. [V:comps]
Blackstone's median paid of 17.1x is above that 75th percentile; the 75th percentile needs $13.1M of EBITDA. [V:comps, T:record]
Ability to pay: 5.0x leverage and a $128M equity cheque give an IRR at the ask of 18.7% against a 20% target. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.reality: Maximum price is $193M on the same exit, so the bid depends on an add-on exit story. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Regional and sector focus
risk_flags.concern: Geography is a slight factor against; only 2 deals are in the target's region. [S:geo_fit, T:record]
risk_flags.mitigant: One of those is Peak Medical Management, a 2021 Midwest deal in the target's sub-sector. [D:MA-2021-0407]
risk_flags.reality: Most of its record sits outside provider services (16 of 25 deals). [T:record]

risk_flags.title: Competitive process and platform gap
risk_flags.concern: No open platform in the sub-sector, and other priority-list buyers have stronger sub-sector records. [A:angles, R:rank]
risk_flags.mitigant: It has done a bolt-on and a SPAC merger in the target's sub-sector. [D:MA-2021-0195, D:MA-2021-0407]
risk_flags.reality: Ranked 7th on the priority list of 10 and 9th overall, with a 4.3% likelihood. [R:rank]

conviction.rationale: Two deals in the target's own sub-sector and seven in adjacent provider sub-sectors support the case; the lack of an open platform in the sub-sector keeps it from High. [C:conviction, T:record]
